fixes.issue: The face is a single row of evenly sized, rounded boulders (~0.6-0.8 m, smooth domes) that read as sandbags or pillows. The concept plinth is angular, fractured basalt chunks of mixed size, 0.3-1.2 m, stacked two or three courses high, with a flat dressed kerb course under the deck.
fixes.target: Replace the rounded_rock domes with faceted, low-poly-fractured rocks (6-10 planar cuts, no smooth caps). Mix sizes 0.3-1.2 m and stack 2-3 courses. Add a 0.15-0.2 m dressed-stone kerb band at deck level across the full front, as in the concept front view. Keep the plinth at ~1.1-1.3 m (the concept measures ~1.3 m against the 5 m bar).

fixes.issue: Seed 1: the steps are a small dark block stack offset left of centre and barely read. The concept has 2-3 broad stone steps on the centre axis, about 2.2-2.5 m wide, cut into the plinth and stepping forward to the ground. Seed 3: the step block renders near-white or silver and reads as a material error.
fixes.target: Centre the steps on the middle bay, step_w 2.2-2.6 m, 3 treads of ~0.35 m rise and ~0.4 m going, in basalt_dry with dressed (flat) faces. Find out which material seed 3's step block gets and put it on basalt.

fixes.issue: The front eave ends in a deep plain fascia board (~0.25-0.3 m), so the roof edge looks thick and boxy. The concept edge is thin and layered: a tile lip over a visible row of rafter ends (taruki) with beam ends (kibana) projecting past the corner posts.
fixes.target: Cut the visible fascia to <=0.12 m. Expose rafter ends at ~0.35-0.4 m spacing under the front and side eaves at LOD0. Let the top beam and nuki run 0.3-0.4 m past the corner posts with cut ends. Raise the corner sori to ~10-12 deg over the last 0.8 m (it reads ~5 deg now; the concept corners visibly lift).

fixes.part: lean-to side wing roof (mirror variant / seed 1)
fixes.issue: The lean-to reads as a flat timber plank deck with a token tile crest on its outer edge. The concept side wing is a small tiled pent roof matching the main roof.
fixes.target: Tile the lean-to with the same kawara row geometry (rings>=3 at LOD0) and pitch it ~20-25 deg. At LOD3, attach its roof plane to its posts: in the 3/4 sheet it floats detached.

fixes.issue: All the timber is one flat, saturated orange-tan hinoki tone with no grain, so posts, deck and fascia merge. lacquer_dark is not visible anywhere. The concept timber is darker, aged warm brown, with darker beams and lintels.
fixes.target: Darken the structural wood_tint ~25% (target base ~0.20/0.13/0.08). Put lacquer_dark on the kamoi/lintels, nuki, ridge cap and deck fascia so the frame reads in two tones. Add planar UV grain direction per member.

fixes.issue: The two lanterns are ~0.45 m tall and sit on the podium face in front of the deck edge, so they look small and stuck on. The concept has ~0.7-0.8 m andon lanterns standing on the deck at the corners, flanking the steps.
fixes.target: Scale the lanterns to ~0.75 m and set them on the deck at both front corners, plus a pair on the step cheeks when steps='front'.

library_issues: kawara reads light taupe-brown; the concept roof is near-black charcoal tile (known issue: kawara too light). Most of the roof mismatch is this, not the generator.
basalt_dry reads matte mid grey-brown with no specular. The concept plinth basalt is near-black with crisp lit edges. Darken the albedo to ~0.04-0.06 and give edges some roughness variation.
washi_backlit emission: the shoji glow is acceptable here but flat and uniform (known issue).
summary: The best part is the timber frame and the roof shape: irimoya, hip and gable seeds all read as Japanese engawa pavilions, and the LOD2/LOD3 phone renders are recognisable. The plinth and the edge detail are what make it look cheap. The rounded pillow boulders, the weak off-centre steps and the thick fascia eaves read as game-asset rather than concept quality. Single-tone orange timber and the light kawara flatten the read. Fix the plinth rocks, steps and eave edge and this is a pass.
